goal: Make the ordinary ChatGPT + GitHub intermediary path immediately usable and prove completion with independent evidence.

lanes.attack: ambiguity, goal drift, incomplete success criteria
unreachable tool path, host-only assumption, stale readiness
static-only validation, code that compiles but cannot execute
worker death, stale state, record corruption, false completion
missing output, corrupt archive, unverified hashes
outdated MCP assumptions, incompatible Node/SDK behavior
floating actions, request-to-shell injection, dependency drift
hidden dependency on Work, Codex, local device, Claude path
untraceable success, missing SHA/run identity, no receipt chain
unsafe request shapes, secret leakage, arbitrary execution, optimistic retry

rule: No lane may claim completion for another lane. Overall PASS requires five-of-five completion methods and ten-of-ten verification lanes on one exact Git SHA.
